en.headline: Russian drone strikes hit residential and infrastructure targets in Ukraine
en.body: A Russian strike drone hit a five-story apartment building in the Kyiv region's Vyshhorod district on Nov. 22, according to The Kyiv Post. Dashcam footage also captured a separate Russian missile strike in Lviv, as reported by Al Jazeera and CBS News.

de.headline: Russische Drohnenangriffe treffen Wohn- und Infrastrukturziele in der Ukraine
de.body: Eine russische Angriffsdrohne traf am 22. November ein fünfstöckiges Wohngebäude im Bezirk Wyschhorod in der Region Kiew, wie die Kyiv Post berichtete. Aufnahmen einer Dashcam dokumentierten zudem einen separaten russischen Raketenangriff in Lwiw, wie Al Jazeera und CBS News meldeten.

it.headline: Attacchi di droni russi colpiscono obiettivi residenziali e infrastrutture in Ucraina
it.body: Un drone d'attacco russo ha colpito un condominio di cinque piani nel distretto di Vyshhorod, nella regione di Kiev, il 22 novembre, secondo quanto riportato dal Kyiv Post. Le riprese di una dashcam hanno inoltre documentato un distinto attacco missilistico russo a Leopoli, come riferito da Al Jazeera e CBS News.

es.headline: Ataques con drones rusos golpean objetivos residenciales e infraestructurales en Ucrania
es.body: Un dron de ataque ruso impactó un edificio de apartamentos de cinco pisos en el distrito de Vyshhorod, en la región de Kiev, el 22 de noviembre, según The Kyiv Post. Grabaciones de cámara de salpicadero también capturaron un ataque separado de misil ruso en Lviv, según informaron Al Jazeera y CBS News.

fr.headline: Des frappes de drones russes frappent des cibles résidentielles et des infrastructures en Ukraine
fr.body: Un drone de frappe russe a touché un immeuble d'appartements de cinq étages dans le district de Vyshhorod, en région de Kyiv, le 22 novembre, selon The Kyiv Post. Des images d'une caméra embarquée ont également capturé une frappe de missile russe distincte à Lviv, comme l'ont rapporté Al Jazeera et CBS News.

pt.headline: Ataques de drones russos atingem alvos residenciais e de infraestrutura na Ucrânia
pt.body: Um drone de ataque russo atingiu um edifício de apartamentos de cinco pisos no distrito de Vyshhorod, na região de Kyiv, a 22 de novembro, segundo The Kyiv Post. Imagens de dashcam capturaram também um ataque separado de míssil russo em Lviv, conforme noticiado pela Al Jazeera e CBS News.

zh.headline: 俄罗斯无人机袭击乌克兰住宅和基础设施目标
zh.body: 根据《基辅邮报》，11月22日，一架俄罗斯攻击无人机击中了基辅地区维什霍罗德区的五层公寓楼。半岛电视台和CBS新闻报道的行车记录仪录像还捕捉到利沃夫发生的另一次俄罗斯导弹袭击。

ja.headline: ロシアのドローン攻撃がウクライナの住宅地とインフラを直撃
ja.body: キエフ・ポストによると、ロシアの攻撃ドローンが11月22日にキエフ州ヴィシュホロド地区の5階建てアパートを直撃した。アルジャジーラとCBSニュースが報じたところによれば、ダッシュカメラの映像にはリヴィウでの別のロシアミサイル攻撃も捉えられている。

ko.headline: 러시아 드론 공격, 우크라이나 주거지 및 기반 시설 목표물 타격
ko.body: 키이우 포스트에 따르면, 러시아 공격 드론이 11월 22일 키이우 지역 비슈호로드 지구의 5층 아파트 건물을 강타했다. 알자지라와 CBS 뉴스는 대시캠 영상이 리비우에서 발생한 별도의 러시아 미사일 공격을 포착했다고 보도했다.

sources.title: Dashcam captures Russian missile strike on Lviv, Ukraine
Russian Drone Destroys 5-Story Apartment Block in Kyiv Region, Trapping 7
Dashcam video captures Russian drone strike in Ukraine

en.headline: Finland reports drone strike on Russian cargo ship in Baltic Sea
en.body: A drone set a Russian cargo ship ablaze in the eastern Baltic Sea on Nov. 21, leading Finnish authorities to state the conflict is "spilling over." According to France 24 and The Guardian, Finnish officials indicated the strike was likely carried out by Ukraine.

de.headline: Finnland meldet Drohnenangriff auf russisches Frachtschiff in der Ostsee
de.body: Eine Drohne setzte am 21. November ein russisches Frachtschiff in der östlichen Ostsee in Brand, was die finnischen Behörden zu der Aussage veranlasste, der Konflikt „weite sich aus“. Laut France 24 und The Guardian deuteten finnische Beamte an, dass der Angriff wahrscheinlich von der Ukraine ausgeführt wurde.

it.headline: La Finlandia segnala un attacco di droni contro una nave cargo russa nel Mar Baltico
it.body: Un drone ha incendiato una nave cargo russa nella parte orientale del Mar Baltico il 21 novembre, portando le autorità finlandesi ad affermare che il conflitto si sta "estendendo". Secondo France 24 e The Guardian, i funzionari finlandesi hanno indicato che l'attacco è stato probabilmente condotto dall'Ucraina.

es.headline: Finlandia informa de ataque con dron a buque de carga ruso en el Mar Báltico
es.body: Un dron incendió un buque de carga ruso en el Mar Báltico oriental el 21 de noviembre, lo que llevó a las autoridades finlandesas a declarar que el conflicto se está "desbordando". Según France 24 y The Guardian, funcionarios finlandeses indicaron que el ataque fue probablemente realizado por Ucrania.

fr.headline: La Finlande signale une frappe de drone sur un cargo russe en mer Baltique
fr.body: Un drone a mis le feu à un cargo russe dans la mer Baltique orientale le 21 novembre, conduisant les autorités finlandaises à déclarer que le conflit était en train de « déborder ». Selon France 24 et The Guardian, des responsables finlandais ont indiqué que la frappe était probablement menée par l'Ukraine.

pt.headline: Finlândia reporta ataque de drone a navio de carga russo no Mar Báltico
pt.body: Um drone incendiou um navio de carga russo no Mar Báltico oriental a 21 de novembro, levando as autoridades finlandesas a afirmar que o conflito está a "transbordar". Segundo France 24 e The Guardian, oficiais finlandeses indicaram que o ataque foi provavelmente realizado pela Ucrânia.

zh.headline: 芬兰报告在波罗的海击中俄罗斯货船的无人机袭击
zh.body: 11月21日，一架无人机在波罗的海东部点燃了一艘俄罗斯货船，芬兰当局表示冲突正在“溢出”。据法国24和《卫报》报道，芬兰官员表示此次袭击很可能由乌克兰执行。

ja.headline: フィンランド、バルト海でロシア貨物船へのドローン攻撃を報告
ja.body: 11月21日、ドローンが東バルト海でロシア貨物船に放火し、フィンランド当局は紛争が「波及している」と述べた。フランス24とガーディアンによると、フィンランド当局者はこの攻撃はウクライナによるものとみられると示唆した。

ko.headline: 핀란드, 발트해 러시아 화물선 드론 공격 보고
ko.body: 11월 21일 동부 발트해에서 드론이 러시아 화물선을 불태웠으며, 핀란드 당국은 이로 인해 분쟁이 '넘쳐흐르고 있다'고 밝혔다. 프랑스 24와 가디언에 따르면, 핀란드 관계자들은 이번 공격이 우크라이나에 의해 수행되었을 가능성이 높다고 시사했다.

sources.title: Live: Finland says Ukraine war 'spilling over' after Baltic Sea drone strike on Russian ship
Krieg in der Ukraine – Russischer Frachter nahe Finnland von Drohnen getroffen
Ukraine war briefing: Russian cargo ship hit by drone in Baltic Sea as Finland PM says conflict ‘spilling over’

en.headline: Ukraine and UK sign agreement for joint drone production
en.body: Ukraine and the UK signed project agreements on Nov. 21 to jointly produce Ukrainian deep-strike and middle-strike drones in Britain. The project is funded by London and the drones will be delivered to the Armed Forces of Ukraine, according to The Kyiv Post.

de.headline: Ukraine und Großbritannien unterzeichnen Abkommen zur gemeinsamen Drohnenproduktion
de.body: Die Ukraine und Großbritannien unterzeichneten am 21. November Projektvereinbarungen zur gemeinsamen Produktion ukrainischer Drohnen für mittlere und große Reichweiten in Großbritannien. Das Projekt wird von London finanziert und die Drohnen werden an die Streitkräfte der Ukraine geliefert, so die Kyiv Post.

it.headline: Ucraina e Regno Unito firmano un accordo per la produzione congiunta di droni
it.body: L'Ucraina e il Regno Unito hanno firmato il 21 novembre accordi di progetto per produrre congiuntamente in Gran Bretagna droni ucraini a lungo e medio raggio. Il progetto è finanziato da Londra e i droni saranno consegnati alle Forze armate ucraine, secondo quanto riportato dal Kyiv Post.

es.headline: Ucrania y Reino Unido firman acuerdo para producción conjunta de drones
es.body: Ucrania y el Reino Unido firmaron acuerdos de proyecto el 21 de noviembre para producir conjuntamente drones ucranianos de ataque profundo y de ataque medio en Gran Bretaña. El proyecto está financiado por Londres y los drones serán entregados a las Fuerzas Armadas de Ucrania, según The Kyiv Post.

fr.headline: L'Ukraine et le Royaume-Uni signent un accord pour la production conjointe de drones
fr.body: L'Ukraine et le Royaume-Uni ont signé des accords de projet le 21 novembre pour produire conjointement des drones ukrainiens de frappe profonde et de frappe moyenne en Grande-Bretagne. Le projet est financé par Londres et les drones seront livrés aux Forces armées ukrainiennes, selon The Kyiv Post.

pt.headline: Ucrânia e Reino Unido assinam acordo para produção conjunta de drones
pt.body: A Ucrânia e o Reino Unido assinaram acordos de projeto a 21 de novembro para produzir em conjunto drones ucranianos de ataque profundo e de ataque médio na Grã-Bretanha. O projeto é financiado por Londres e os drones serão entregues às Forças Armadas da Ucrânia, segundo The Kyiv Post.

zh.headline: 乌克兰和英国签署联合无人机生产协议
zh.body: 根据《基辅邮报》，乌克兰和英国于11月21日签署了项目协议，将在英国联合生产乌克兰的深度打击和中程打击无人机。该项目由伦敦资助，无人机将交付给乌克兰武装部队。

ja.headline: ウクライナと英国、共同ドローン生産に関する合意に署名
ja.body: ウクライナと英国は11月21日、英国でウクライナの深部打撃および中距離打撃ドローンを共同生産するためのプロジェクト合意に署名した。キエフ・ポストによると、このプロジェクトはロンドンによって資金提供され、ドローンはウクライナ軍に納入される予定である。

ko.headline: 우크라이나와 영국, 공동 드론 생산 협정 체결
ko.body: 우크라이나와 영국은 11월 21일 영국에서 우크라이나 심층 타격 및 중거리 타격 드론을 공동 생산하기 위한 프로젝트 협정을 체결했다. 키이우 포스트에 따르면, 이 프로젝트는 런던이 자금을 지원하며, 생산된 드론은 우크라이나군에 인도될 예정이다.

sources.title: Ukraine, UK Agree to Jointly Produce Ukrainian Deep-Strike Drones in Britain
Ukraine, UK Agree to Jointly Produce Ukrainian Deep-Strike Drones in Britain

en.title: Russia-Ukraine War Escalation
en.dek: Developments unfold as a Baltic Sea drone strike on a Russian ship prompts warnings from Finland, alongside heavy aerial attacks in Kyiv and Lviv and a new UK-Ukraine drone production agreement.

de.title: Eskalation im Russland-Ukrainischer Krieg
de.dek: Die Ereignisse überschlagen sich, als ein Drohnenangriff auf ein russisches Schiff in der Ostsee Warnungen aus Finnland auslöst, während gleichzeitig schwere Luftangriffe auf Kiew und Lwiw sowie ein neues britisch-ukrainisches Abkommen zur Drohnenproduktion erfolgen.

es.title: Escalada de la guerra ruso-ucraniana
es.dek: Se producen nuevos acontecimientos después de que un ataque con drones en el mar Báltico contra un buque ruso desencadene advertencias por parte de Finlandia, junto con intensos ataques aéreos en Kiev y Leópolis y un nuevo acuerdo de producción de drones entre el Reino Unido y Ucrania.

fr.title: Escalade de la guerre entre la Russie et l'Ukraine
fr.dek: La situation évolue alors qu'une attaque de drone en mer Noire contre un navire russe suscite des avertissements de la Finlande, parallèlement à d'intenses attaques aériennes à Kyiv et Lviv et à un nouvel accord de production de drones entre le Royaume-Uni et l'Ukraine.

pt.title: Escalada da Guerra Rússia-Ucrânia
pt.dek: Novos desenvolvimentos ocorrem à medida que um ataque com drone no mar Báltico contra um navio russo gera avisos por parte da Finlândia, a par de intensos ataques aéreos em Kiev e Lviv e de um novo acordo de produção de drones entre o Reino Unido e a Ucrânia.

it.title: Escalation della guerra tra Russia e Ucraina
it.dek: Si susseguono gli sviluppi mentre un attacco con droni nel Mar Baltico contro una nave russa suscita gli avvertimenti della Finlandia, insieme a pesanti attacchi aerei a Kiev e Leopoli e a un nuovo accordo di produzione di droni tra Regno Unito e Ucraina.

zh.title: 俄乌冲突升级
zh.dek: 波罗的海针对一艘俄罗斯船只的无人机袭击引发芬兰警告，基辅和利沃夫遭到猛烈空袭，英国与乌克兰签署了新的无人机生产协议，局势不断发展。

ja.title: ロシア・ウクライナ戦争の激化
ja.dek: バルト海でのロシア船に対するドローン攻撃を受けてフィンランドが警告を発したほか、キーウやリヴィウで大規模な空爆が行われ、さらに英国とウクライナの間で新たなドローン共同生産に関する合意が結ばれるなど、事態が展開している。

ko.title: 러시아-우크라이나 전쟁 격화
ko.dek: 발트해의 러시아 선박에 대한 드론 공격으로 핀란드의 경고가 촉발된 가운데, 키이우와 르비우에 대한 대규모 공습과 영국의 새로운 우크라이나 드론 생산 협정이 이어지며 관련 상황들이 전개되고 있다.

en.title: Finland reports drone strike on Russian cargo ship in Baltic Sea; Ukraine and UK sign drone production deal
en.dek: Finnish authorities say conflict is spilling over after ship fire; UK and Ukraine agree to joint drone production
facts: Finnish authorities state a drone set a Russian cargo ship ablaze in the eastern Baltic Sea on Nov. 21, calling the conflict spilling over
Finnish officials indicated the strike was likely carried out by Ukraine according to France 24 and The Guardian
Ukraine and the UK signed project agreements on Nov. 21 to jointly produce Ukrainian deep-strike and middle-strike drones in Britain
The project is funded by London and drones will be delivered to the Armed Forces of Ukraine according to The Kyiv Post
A Russian strike drone hit a five-story apartment building in Kyiv region's Vyshhorod district on Nov. 22 according to The Kyiv Post
Dashcam footage captured a separate Russian missile strike in Lviv on Nov. 22 as reported by Al Jazeera and CBS News
body: Finnish authorities reported on Nov. 22 that a drone set a Russian cargo ship ablaze in the eastern Baltic Sea on Nov. 21, stating the conflict is spilling over, according to France 24 and The Guardian.
Finnish officials indicated the strike was likely carried out by Ukraine, as reported by France 24 and The Guardian.

Ukraine and the UK signed project agreements on Nov. 21 to jointly produce Ukrainian deep-strike and middle-strike drones in Britain, with the project funded by London and drones to be delivered to the Armed Forces of Ukraine, according to The Kyiv Post.
A Russian strike drone hit a five-story apartment building in the Kyiv region's Vyshhorod district on Nov. 22, according to The Kyiv Post.
Dashcam footage also captured a separate Russian missile strike in Lviv on Nov. 22, as reported by Al Jazeera and CBS News.
The developments mark a continuation of hostilities with new actions on multiple fronts including maritime, aerial production, and residential targets.
Context from earlier updates indicates the war has seen repeated drone and missile strikes across Ukrainian territory and Baltic region maritime traffic.
en.context: The Russia-Ukraine war has seen repeated exchanges of drone and missile strikes, with maritime incidents in the Baltic Sea and residential targets hit across Ukraine, as multiple outlets have reported on Nov. 22, 2026.
